What counts as a case

Not a prompt.
Not a thumbnail.

A case has a specific user job, concrete subject, cliché filter, one structural signature, clean automated QA, exact small-size renders, a current contract-bound receipt, and a reusable case record. This edition kept 100 of 111 generated directions.

Separate collections

Practice at scale.
Admission stays honest.

These studies do not change the 100-case Gallery count. Each carries its own catalog, status, and evidence.
